memories.content: Apple has not yet publicly confirmed the keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. Internally, they are considering options and may have a decision but have not announced it.

Macworld San Francisco 2007 is scheduled for January 8-12, 2007. The opening keynote is traditionally a major event. As of December 1, 2006, Apple has not publicly confirmed who will deliver the keynote. The conference begins on January 8, 2007 at 9:00 AM PST.

memories.content: Steve Jobs is the CEO of Apple and has been the keynote speaker at previous Macworld events. He is aware that the conference is approaching and that a decision about the keynote speaker needs to be made.
